description: keep git based? Partially open source? Like github? People come with their repos, we do the hosting people stay with us because it's convenient?

status.comment: Felix 2026-11-11, direction (details open): two storage engines behind one clean interface. Git engine: open source and free, for open-source projects and for running Aimparency locally. Hosted engine: for organizations and companies maintaining a vision graph, with faster sync and no commit logic, under a proprietary license, paid. Still open: the license of the open part (ISC lets anyone sell their own hosted engine against the interface), where exactly the interface sits, and how Commons Hub starts. The per-user worktree design (53a03e76) no longer fits this direction.
